summary.text: Anthony Dasaro, also known as Tony, is the Democratic candidate for the West Virginia House of Delegates, District 55, in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A physician, he defeated Aaron Crank in the Democratic primary on May 12, 2026, and faces incumbent Republican JB Akers.

paragraphs.text: Dasaro earned a high school diploma from Xavier High School, a bachelor's degree from Fordham University in 1973, and a graduate degree from the State University of New York at Buffalo in 1993.
His career experience includes working as a physician.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Dasaro said he would defend the state's immunization standards, seek an audit of the state budget to prioritize the Public Employees Insurance Agency and teachers, and support local control over data center development.

He listed health care access, cost and accountability, workers and labor, flood relief and clean water, and guardrails on incoming businesses such as data centers as policy areas he cares about, and named the AFL-CIO among his endorsers.
